name: Drowned Thing
desc: Whatever has been living in the flooded levels of Maris Deep.

intro: Something climbs out of the flooded stairwell behind you, streaming black water, with a station ID badge tangled in what it has for a chest.
You hear wet footsteps keeping time with yours. They stop when you stop.
hit: A cold, wet weight wraps around your arm and starts pulling you toward the water.
It hits you with something that bends in too many places, and the cold soaks into you.
Black water fills your mouth from nowhere, and for a moment you're at the bottom of the sea.
miss: It reaches for you and closes on nothing, and the water running off it hisses on the deck.
You scramble back from the edge as it surges up, and it slides under again without a ripple.
It comes at you in the dark, and misses, and you hear it breathing water right behind you.
crit: It gets you under, only for a few seconds, and down there in the dark you hear a calm voice reading out numbers.
defeated: It slumps apart into a spreading pool around your boots, and the badge is left lying in the wet.
It sinks back into the flooded stairwell, the water goes flat and still, and you keep your eyes on it as you back away.
joins: The water behind you bulges, and {enemy} hauls itself up out of it.
stunned: {Enemy} sways where it stands, dripping, as if it has forgotten what you are.
